full_text: Hello. Hello. Badhiya hai ji aap batao. Kahan se ho? Kya karte ho? Single ho married ho? Married. Kitna time ho gaya aapki shadi ko? Teen saal. Aur bataiye bacche bhi honge fir toh. Toh abhi kahan gayi wife aapki? Main bhi married hoon main Delhi se hoon. Hmm?
